basic_info.description: Welcome to your new home in the vibrant city of San Francisco! This charming property offers 1,350 square feet of living space, featuring 2 bedrooms with a reverse floor plan, with white water ocean views. The kitchen boasts granite countertops, top of the line stainless steel appliances, perfect for preparing meals and entertaining in the formal dining room. Enjoy the warmth of the central forced air heating system and the ambiance of the formal living room, with its cozy fireplace.  Gleaming hardwood flooring runs throughout the home, adding elegance and ease of maintenance. For convenience, laundry facilities equipped with washer and dryer, family room/bedroom with half bathroom, are located in the garage, The property is situated on a 2,996 square foot lot, with beautifully, landscaped yard, providing a comfortable outdoor area. Additionally, plenty of garage space, parking will never be an issue. Enjoy nearby shops, banks and restaurants on Noriega. This home is an ideal choice for those seeking comfort and functionality in the heart of San Francisco.
